description: A clone in the image of Htilit, Goddess of the Trinity. She is thus named due to the three power sources that she possesses: Llewxam’s power of the portal, the Grail, and Corruption. This divinity is behind the events related to Sagrav in the Mirror world, as well as the Convergence. Htilit likes to “play,” as she puts it, with humans. That’s why she decided to try to conquer her home world, the Mirror world. After failing, she decided to prepare a much more elaborate plan. After the events with Yggdrasil, she managed to capture Llewxam in order to torture her, but more than that, she wanted to steal her powers. She then managed to obtain the Grail and control the Corruption to form her infamous trinity. All of this power allowed her to threaten the universe by using machines to disrupt the Rift. She then hoped to take control of the powerful Apex champions so she could “play” with them. Despite her great power, this clone is incomplete since she doesn't possess the true powers of the trinity.
summon: Never give up! You need to become the most powerful of my toys!
fusion: My trinity is perfect! I don’t need any more, but if you insist...
